## Summary

Describe the user problem and the change made to address it.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `pnpm check`.
- [ ] I ran `pnpm build`.
- [ ] I tested the affected interaction in a browser.

## Impact

- [ ] This change updates documentation where needed.
- [ ] This change preserves browser-local handling of handwriting content, samples, profiles, and exported media.
- [ ] This change has no breaking change, or the breaking change is documented below.

## Notes for reviewers

Include screenshots, accessibility considerations, mobile-layout impact, export-format impact, or migration notes when relevant. Do not include private handwriting samples or note content.
